issues.what: Learner B's 'inner 3-fold' threshold selection is degenerate: the inner test blocks are interleaved (tr_blocks[i::3]) while the purge removes every training trade between the first and last inner test block, so 2 of the 3 inner models per outer fold train on a single block (1m: 250-492 trades; 5m: 47-82 trades). p* is then a quantile of weak-model probabilities applied to the full outer model, which explains p* = 'never exit' in 2/3 1-minute folds and 0% early exits on 5m despite p* 0.942/0.958. Not a leak (strictly conservative), and B is not a candidate, but the FINDINGS does not disclose it and B's +100.8 is a weak estimate of what hindsight imitation could do.
